method.entry: range high, or current open after an opening gap
method.frequency: maximum one trade per day, entry before 15:15 IST
method.same_bar_rule: SL first when SL and TP are both touched
method.pnl: normalized at Rs 1,000 per 1R; excludes option behavior and costs

limitations: NIFTY spot is a signal instrument and cannot be traded directly.
This is not a historical NIFTY option-premium or continuous-futures backtest.
Historical option OI changes are not available in the candle response.
Dhan NIFTY index volume can be synthetic/cumulative; volume results are experimental.
